description: Runs Node.js applications with pnpm. Any Node.js and pnpm version, deployment from Git with auto updates, and a persistent pnpm store for fast installs.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Nothing to install up front: on every start the image clones or updates the
# Git repository, selects Node.js and pnpm, and installs dependencies with the
# correct paths and permissions of the running server.
mkdir -p /mnt/server
echo "Done. The repository is cloned and dependencies are installed when the server starts."

variables.name: Start Script
variables.description: package.json script that starts the application (pnpm run <script>).

variables.name: Node.js Version
variables.description: Empty uses the bundled Node.js LTS. Otherwise any version pnpm can install: a major (22), an exact version (20.18.1), lts or latest. Downloaded once and cached.

variables.name: pnpm Version
variables.description: Empty uses the bundled pnpm, which follows the project's packageManager field. Otherwise a version or range (10, 9.15.9, latest) that overrides it.

variables.name: Git Repository
variables.description: HTTPS URL of the repository to deploy. Empty disables Git (upload files manually).

variables.name: Git Branch
variables.description: Branch to deploy. Empty uses the repository's default branch.

variables.name: Git Username
variables.description: Username for private repositories (optional; any value works for GitHub tokens).

variables.name: Git Access Token
variables.description: Personal access token for private repositories. Only sent to the repository's host and never written to disk.

variables.name: Auto Update
variables.description: Update to the latest commit of the branch on every start. Local edits to tracked files are replaced; untracked files such as .env are kept.

variables.name: Install Dependencies
variables.description: Run pnpm install on every start (fast when nothing changed).

variables.name: Install Flags
variables.description: Extra flags for pnpm install, e.g. --prod or --frozen-lockfile.

variables.name: Allow Build Scripts
variables.description: Allow all dependency build scripts (pnpm blocks them by default). Prefer listing trusted packages under allowBuilds in pnpm-workspace.yaml.

variables.name: Build Script
variables.description: package.json script run after installing and before starting, e.g. build. Empty skips it.
